Conclusion: The test `pandas.tests.reshape.test_pivot.TestPivotTable.test_pivot_table_multiindex_only()` checks whether the `pivot_table` method correctly handles MultiIndex columns when called with only column names provided. However, the test failed with an `AttributeError`: 'Series' object has no attribute 'columns'. Upon investigating the code snippet of the `pivot_table` method in pandas.core.frame.DataFrame, we find that it does not handle the case where only column names are passed for indexing correctly when the DataFrame has MultiIndex columns. Instead of using the provided column names, it attempts to access the 'columns' attribute of the Series object resulting from selecting values with `values="v"`, leading to the AttributeError.

The best locations to fix this issue would be:

```
pandas.core.frame.DataFrame.pivot_table(values=None, index=None, columns=None)
```
